Got a step-by-step drawing tutorial? Here's how to turn it into one video.
Step one. Tap Replace and upload your tutorial sheet.
Strokeberry finds the panels for you.
Step two. Each panel becomes a step. Rename or reorder them if you need to.
Keep auto-align on, then tap Prepare drawing steps.
Step three. Tap any step to jump to it. Set the length to twenty seconds, then pick nine by sixteen and Full HD.
Step four. Press play, and watch each step build on the last.
Step five. Tap Export, then download your MP4.
One sheet, one video. Open the studio and try it with your own tutorial.
